verses.text: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will. I write to God's holy people in Ephesus, who are faithful in Christ Jesus.
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. He has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places.
Even before he made the world, God chose us in Christ to be holy and without fault in his sight. In love
he decided long ago to adopt us as his children through Jesus Christ. This was what he wanted, and it gave him pleasure.
So we praise God for his glorious grace, which he freely gave us in the Son he loves.
In Christ we are set free through his blood, and our sins are forgiven. This shows how rich God's grace is.
He poured out his grace on us, with all wisdom and understanding.
He let us know the secret of his plan. It was his good purpose, which he planned in Christ.
When the right time comes, he will bring everything together under Christ, everything in heaven and on earth.
In Christ we were also chosen to receive an inheritance. God planned this long ago. He makes everything work out the way he decides.
He did this so that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, would bring praise to his glory.
You too heard the message of truth, the Good News that saves you. When you believed in Christ, God marked you with his seal, the Holy Spirit he promised.
The Spirit is the guarantee of what we will receive, until God sets free those who belong to him. This brings praise to his glory.
That is why I keep thinking of you. I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
I never stop thanking God for you, and I remember you in my prayers.
I keep asking the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, to give you the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, so that you know him better.
I pray that the eyes of your heart may be opened. Then you will know the hope he has called you to. You will know how rich and glorious his inheritance is among his holy people.
And you will know his great power, which is far beyond anything, for us who believe. It is the same mighty strength
that he used when he raised Christ from the dead. God seated him at his right hand in the heavenly places.
Christ is far above every ruler, authority, power and lord, and above every name that can be named, not only in this age but also in the age to come.
God put everything under his feet. He made him head over everything for the church.
The church is his body. It is filled by Christ, who fills everything in every way.
